messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Lattice-based integer-coordinate grid constructions with computational area proofs

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A configuration of 13 points on a 7x7 integer lattice grid, selected via simulated annealing to maximize the minimum triangle area, achieves a largest minimum triangle area of 1/49, where every triangle formed by any three of the 13 points has area at least 1/49 (equivalently 2/98 in determinant form). The specific point set is {(0,0),(1,5),(2,1),(3,6),(4,2),(5,0),(6,3),(0,4),(2,6),(4,5),(6,6),(1,2),(5,4)}, and the minimum area bound of 1/49 is verified by exhaustive computation over all 286 triples, with each triangle area computed via the integer determinant formula |x1(y2-y3)+x2(y3-y1)+x3(y1-y2)|/2. This construction is conjectured to be optimal among all lattice-based configurations on grids up to 12x12, as no simulated annealing run on any grid size from 4x4 through 12x12 found a minimum triangle area exceeding 1/49."}
